content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available – 1 for Project Research Scientist-II (Medical), 2 for Project Research Scientist-I (Medical), and 1 for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical).

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist II (Medical): MBBS / BVSc / BDS with three years’ post qualification experience OR MBBS / BVSc / BDS + Post Graduate Degree (MD/MVSc./MDS/MPH) or any equivalent degree, including integrated PG degrees OR MBBS/BVSc/ BDS with PhD Project Research Scientist I (Medical): MBBS/BVSc/BDS or equivalent Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees OR For Engineering / IT / CS - Four Years Graduate Degree

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years for all posts. Age relaxation admissible for SC/ST/OBC candidates, Retrenched Government Employees, and ex-servicemen as per Central Government instructions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Bhopal Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Research Scientist posts at AIIMS Bhopal?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) is 03-09-2026, while for Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) and Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) it is 14-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist-I (Medical)?
faq.answer: The educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) is MBBS/BVSc/BDS or an equivalent degree.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Project Research Scientist posts is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for the AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist positions?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending their complete application along with required documents via email.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 80000 + 20% HRA to Rs. 56000 + 20% HRA, depending on the post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies announced by AIIMS Bhopal?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bhopal has announced a total of 4 vacancies for the Project Research Scientist posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.
